findings.verifierReasoning: The real §7.2(c) basket is limited to Indebtedness secured by Liens permitted by Section 7.3(g). The proposed IR would allow any Indebtedness whenever the Section 7.1 pro forma compliance condition is satisfied. A hypothetical unsecured borrowing that satisfies Section 7.1 would be outside the real §7.2(c) basket but would appear to be permitted by the proposed IR. This changes the scope of the permission and is material.

findings.verifierReasoning: The source fixes the measurement date as the last day of the most recently ended fiscal quarter for which financial statements are available, with the incurrence treated as if it had occurred on the first day of each relevant period. The IR leaves the date unspecified, so compliance could be computed as of a different date and produce a different result. The IR also types the Section 7.1 financial-covenant metric as MONEY, which the source does not support; financial covenants are not expressed as a dollar amount in this clause. Both defects are material to any downstream computation of the gating condition.
